notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.content:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on July 18th.
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

Early Access and Beyond
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: Vorax at Gamescom with Open Alpha Ready to Play
notes.content:
HUGE Progress Update on our newest game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/e720f54b3a2868a7d11c877b3123dd2b65ef0c84.jpg
We know we usually don't post about this that often, sorry for the long post, but this is a special occasion that we wanted to share with all the community, thank you for your patience. More surprises are coming soon. You can try the updated Open Alpha or Demo for FREE today.

In just a few days we will be present at Gamescom 2023, in Germany. You will be able to find us in hall 10.1 booth B-093 and hall 02.1 stand A-0007.

But for those at home, who can't make it, we also have something HUGE for you. Gain access to a 10 times bigger map (10 square kilometers), vehicles, new weapons and zones. Find out more.

[previewyoutube=AwZUSuHQsYs;full][/previewyoutube]

An updated Steam demo and an updated full build. Also exclusive open alpha opportunity for the most loyal fans. 

We are talking about new weapons, an expanded map, new enemies and a whole lot more.

Updated Steam Demo & Open Alpha
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

If you do not own it yet on Steam, it's fine. You can play the Updated Demo on Steam right now. It's free, it has most of the new elements added to it, you can get a taste of what's to come at Gamescom. Even if on a smaller map (only 1km2), the horror and survival will be the same, just in a smaller dose. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/5bd4cd61393d3c1040ab090db02f2e64ffe8d4fd.jpg

If you are interested to spice the experience, you can try the Open Alpha on our website. Which, it brings all of the above mentioned plus two exclusive weapons: SAP-6 and the AK-47. With these bad boys at your side your survival chances will exponentially grow...if you find the ammo for them. Find them somewhere well hidden on the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/8a01ee88bc3cad223cb590cf9685853ae1c01d55.jpg

Something HUGE for those who got Full Game Early

Not only you will get access to everything mentioned earlier, but also the possibility to explore the full map. Nearly 10 times bigger (10 square kilometers), with vehicles, new weapons, new enemies and a lot more. Your experience will be close to similar to those from Gamescom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/db9fab173a6ab7412c069efa1d9702ffa85a90e9.jpg

If you haven't bought it already, you can get it directly, early and cheaper from our website and support our development progress. If you did, you can already head to your profile library and download the new updated build right now. Keep in mind it does get updated regularly, so you can check back again later for something new.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/9011f1e1c6c6347a0d12bdb49ecd11648e605e51.jpg

And yes, of course, you will also get a Steam Key as soon as it releases on Steam, you will not be forgotten. But in the meantime, make sure you wishlist it, if you haven't already. And if you will be in Cologne next week, see you there, let's meet.

notes.title: Blockstorm is now FREE on Steam!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Blockstorm, the voxel first-person shooter game, our first passion project (but not our last), is now free to play on Steam, forever and for everyone!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/263060/Blockstorm/
What's Blockstorm again?
For the newcomers, Blockstorm is a fast-paced game that combines the classic elements of first-person shooters with the endless creativity of sandbox games. With an extensive collection of customizable weapons, maps, and game modes, Blockstorm offers endless hours of fun and excitement for both you and your friends.
[previewyoutube=BQdJv9Rqse0;full][/previewyoutube]
From today onwards, players can download and play Blockstorm for free on Steam. This means that everyone can now experience the adrenaline rush of shooting and building their way through the game's dynamic levels without having to pay a penny. 

Why go free to play?
We want to thank our dedicated community of players for their support and feedback over the years. We hope that going free-to-play, our gift to all of our loyal fans and involved community, will encourage even more players to join the Blockstorm community and enjoy the game.

So, what are you waiting for? Download Blockstorm for free on Steam today and start building, fighting, and creating your own adventure. We can't wait to see you on the battlefield! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/
And since we are on the topic of passion projects, our latest one is called Vorax. It’s an Open World Survival Horror game. Feel free to check it out, try it and even maybe wishlist it to stay updated on its release.

We look forward to seeing you in the game!

Best regards,
The IndieGala Team

notes.title: Die Young: Prologue is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Play Die Young: Prologue now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/973000/Die_Young_Prologue/

https://i.imgur.com/sWFXqKK.jpg

Get ready to slowly merge into Die Young's full story starting right from the roots! 

Play as Nehir, a field agent of a well-known political party trying to deconstruct and eliminate Brother n.1, the leader of Island's community. 

The Prologue covers her desperate attempt to reach the rendezvous point. Will she be able to save herself or will she die young?


Die Young: Prologue is an action-adventure with a more linear structure than the open-world of Die Young, but it leaves the player with the possibility of using different approaches and paths to escape.
The game consists of three levels: Introductory, Main, Final. 
If players choose to explore these levels, they'll discover several useful items that'll unravel the deep lore behind Die Young.

We hope you enjoy this free prequel game!
